reasoning:
Since this is the first round with no prior edits, I'm drafting the main revisions: updating the annotator prompt for buttons pressed, adding a freezing clause for the colored containers, revising the policy memory for button signs and container appearance, and making sure the subgoal opens by mentioning the memory update first.

For the subgoal clause, it already states "after updating memory for this step," so adding more there would be redundant—I'll leave it as is and focus on quoting the exact passages that need changing.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: Apply the first matching rule, after updating memory for this step:
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: First update memory for this step (in particular buttons_pressed, using the press signs named in the memory instruction: the phrase 'is pressed down', or the gripper on a button at height 0.035 or lower with fingers closed, usually with two containers swapping). Then apply the first matching rule:

edits.modify_from: Carried-in count plus 1 if any execution frame shown at this step says a button 'is pressed down'; otherwise the carried-in count. Start at 0. e.g. 1
edits.modify_to: Carried-in count plus 1 if any execution frame shown at this step either reports a button 'is pressed down' or shows the gripper within a few pixels of a button's listed position at height 0.035 or lower with fingers closed (two containers gliding and swapping in neighbouring frames confirms the same press); otherwise the carried-in count. Count at most one press per step. Start at 0. e.g. 1

edits.modify_from: When containers appear, take the one standing on the carried-in green position.
edits.modify_to: In the step where containers appear, the field becomes the position of the container standing on the carried-in green position, even if that container never moves.

edits.modify_from: If the green cube is exposed by lifting its container, write the exposed cube's position. Start with the cube position seen at the first step. e.g. [109, 126]
edits.modify_to: Once a frame shows the green cube exposed beneath a container held in the gripper, write the cube's last visible position and freeze the field; a container later set down over the cube does not update it. Start with the cube position seen at the first step. e.g. [136, 108]

edits.modify_from: kept exactly as green_container: cube position when visible, then the container that covered it, followed frame to frame (two movers during a press swap places), written at the last frame shown. e.g. [82, 152]
edits.modify_to: kept exactly as green_container: cube position before containers exist; from the step where containers appear, the container standing on the carried-in position (even one that never moves), followed frame to frame (two movers during a press swap places), written at the last frame shown; once the red cube is seen exposed beneath a container held in the gripper, the cube's last visible position, frozen regardless of any container later set down over it. e.g. [100, 166]
